Email: info@deesheng.food
WhatsApp / Tel: +86 156 2108 9573

## Product and order qualification

- Product and pack specifications are specific to the named variant. Catalogue entries can represent flavors or pack formats and are not a count of unique formulas.
- Where a field requires confirmation, request the current specification for the exact SKU. Do not infer shelf life, storage, carton logistics, ingredients or allergens from another product or packaging format.
- Kimchi and pickled-vegetable packs and carton dimensions are listed by named product or variant. Whole, cut and diced cabbage kimchi and retail jars have separate pack specifications. Shelf life, storage and transport conditions require confirmation for the selected product and order; frozen kimchi projects require their own specification.
- MOQ, samples, quotation, production timing and shipment terms are confirmed for the selected product, formula, pack, quantity and destination. Prices are not published.
- Relevant factory credentials include BRCGS Grade A, HACCP, HALAL and OU Kosher. Check current validity, manufacturing site, product and formula coverage, and destination recognition before order approval; a credential list does not certify every catalogue item.

## Product families and catalogue selections

### Korean Sauces

URL: https://deesheng.food/products/korean-sauces/
Wholesale Korean sauces from Qingdao for food importers, distributors, restaurant suppliers and private-label brands. Compare gochujang, fried-chicken glazes, buldak, BBQ sauces and related seasonings in retail and foodservice packs.
Tell us your target market, sales channel, products, preferred packs and estimated cartons. We will confirm the formula, label requirements and quotation for your order.

## Detailed product specifications

### Gochujang — Korean Chili Paste

URL: https://deesheng.food/product/gochujang/
Deesheng Food supplies Korean-style gochujang, a red pepper paste for importers, distributors, restaurant suppliers and private-label brands. The confirmed formats are 500 g tubs packed 20 per carton and a 14 kg foodservice carton. Both have a 12-month shelf life with ambient storage away from light. Choose the smaller format for retail distribution or the bulk format for commercial kitchens. Evaluate the selected formula for your desired balance of heat and sweetness. Share your destination, sales channel, selected pack and estimated quantity to request a matching sample, product documents and a quotation.
Applications: Bibimbap; Marinades; Stir-fry; Dipping sauces; Soup and stew bases.

- 500 g tub × 20: 12 months; storage: Ambient; away from light; net 10 kg; gross 11.5 kg; carton 490 × 260 × 175 mm.
- 14 kg foodservice carton: 12 months; storage: Ambient; away from light; net 14 kg; gross 14.8 kg; carton 245 × 240 × 255 mm.

Carton dimensions are length × width × height. Confirm the selected retail pack or 14 kg inner-container construction and final label with your order.

Q: Can it be supplied for private label?
A: OEM and private-label enquiries can cover the label, packaging and proposed flavor adjustments. Share the destination, required format and expected volume so the formula, artwork, documents and production scope can be agreed for your project.

Q: Which gochujang packs are available?
A: The confirmed formats are 500 g tubs × 20 per carton and 14 kg foodservice cartons. The 500 g carton has a net weight of 10 kg and gross weight of 11.5 kg; the 14 kg carton has a gross weight of 14.8 kg. Request a separate specification for any other retail size.

Q: What are the shelf life and storage conditions?
A: The listed shelf life is 12 months with ambient storage away from light. Follow the selected product label for handling, temperature limits and storage after opening; the unopened shelf life is not an after-opening period.

Q: What heat level should I choose?
A: Select the heat and sweetness balance by testing the proposed formula in your intended dish. No measured Scoville value is specified here. Extra Hot Gochujang is a separate product and requires its own sample and specification.

Q: Is Korean-style a statement of origin?
A: Korean-style describes the product style. Deesheng Food is based in Qingdao, China. Request the product-specific manufacturing-site and origin documents for your order.

Q: Can I compare it with other Korean pastes?
A: Korean Garlic Sauce and Korean Doenjang are separate products with their own formulas and specifications. Choose by the intended recipe and approve a sample instead of treating the pastes as interchangeable.

Q: How do I check ingredients, allergens and certification?
A: Request the current ingredient list, allergen declaration and any documents required for your destination. Certification must match the manufacturing site, selected product, formula and current certificate scope. A product name or pack size does not establish dietary suitability.

Q: How can I request samples and a quotation?
A: Send the product name, destination, sales channel, intended application, selected pack and estimated quantity. We will confirm the sample arrangements, quotation, MOQ and lead time for that project. Sample and freight terms are agreed before dispatch.

### Classic Korean-Style Fire Noodle Sauce

URL: https://deesheng.food/product/classic-buldak-sauce/
Deesheng Food supplies classic Korean-style fire noodle sauce for importers, distributors, noodle brands and foodservice buyers. This is a sauce for noodle dishes, not finished instant noodles. Available formats are 200 g bottles × 24, 350 g bottles × 24, 400 g bottles × 30, and 1 kg pouches in 10- or 12-pouch cartons. The listed shelf life is 12 months under ambient storage away from light. Approve the formula in your intended recipe before ordering. Share your destination, sales channel, selected pack and estimated quantity to request a matching sample, product documents and a quotation.
Applications: Spicy noodles; Fried chicken; Rice bowls; Dipping; Restaurant sauce programs.

- 200 g bottle × 24: 12 months; storage: Ambient; away from light; net 4.8 kg; gross 5.75 kg; carton 270 × 270 × 135 mm.
- 350 g bottle × 24: 12 months; storage: Ambient; away from light; net 8.4 kg; gross 9.8 kg; carton 345 × 285 × 180 mm.
- 400 g bottle × 30: 12 months; storage: Ambient; away from light; net 12 kg; gross 13.7 kg; carton 485 × 285 × 183 mm.
- 1 kg pouch × 12: 12 months; storage: Ambient; away from light; net 12 kg; gross 12.85 kg; carton 320 × 240 × 250 mm.
- 1 kg pouch × 10: 12 months; storage: Ambient; away from light; Carton logistics available on request.

Carton dimensions are length × width × height. Carton logistics available on request. Do not reuse the 12-pouch carton data for the 10-pouch option.

Q: Is this sauce or finished instant noodles?
A: It is a sauce for preparing fire-noodle dishes. Noodles and finished meal kits are not included in this product specification.

Q: Which retail and foodservice packs are available?
A: Choose 200 g bottles × 24, 350 g bottles × 24, 400 g bottles × 30, or 1 kg pouches in 10- or 12-pouch cartons. Specify the carton configuration in your inquiry. Shipping data for the 12-pouch carton must not be applied to the 10-pouch carton.

Q: How hot is the classic version?
